name: Old Synagogue (Essen)
scope: The principal standing Old Synagogue in Essen, with the Steeler Tor entrance, drum and main dome, curved lateral galleries, flanking towers, and the rear wall. Roofs follow the city’s documented restoration.
era: 1913 structure in its current museum use, representing the documented roof restoration to its permanent form.

originalReview.notes: The original title page, architect’s ground plan, four elevations and lengthwise section. Use is restricted to the original architectural drawings, published in Berlin in 1914.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Started with Qualla’s published candidates. The verified modern PD-self original shows the former interior ark only. The local exterior postcard copies have insufficiently documented original publishing imprints for this use. Used only the measured drawings by named architect Edmund Körner, published in 1914 and preserved in the exact USHMM Rare Book Collection scan.
